route: Balanced line input -> channel fader -> hard-left pan -> main L sum -> main master -> balanced XLR output
eq: Bypassed; residual loading from unused EQ/low-cut branches omitted
output_connection: pin2 minus pin3, each leg loaded by 10 kohm to ground
heldout_description: 0-3 s Talking Hedz filtered bass at explicit -12.0412 dB before desk; 3-6 s independent percussion; 6-8 s independent bass; 8-9 s recovery. No training or selection on these targets.
omissions: EQ and low-cut branch residual loads
solver: Gear, reltol 1e-4, abstol 1e-12, vntol 1e-7, itl4 10; original filesource, 4x maximum timestep and uniform storage
record_state: Independent circuit operating point and 0.5 seconds of zero input per record. Training and inference reset recurrent state at the same record boundaries.
fresh_training: 32-unit model trained from zero on this pair for a plugin CPU budget of about 5 percent of a core per instance
